items.raw_role: source-declared tentative first-guess action term status
items.preserved_text: The non-gravitational bosonic action contains torsion, Higgs kinetic, electroweak, strong, and new-field pieces; L01 explicitly calls the new-field action a first guess likely to change.
L01 states that the Hodge-star construction requires extracting and inverting the frame part of the E8 connection and calls this procedure awkward and in need of a more natural justification.

L01 derives a one-generation massive Dirac action with standard Higgs coupling plus new w and xPhi fermion couplings; the latter are not well understood, and the actions for the other two triality-related generations are not known well enough to write down.

items.raw_role: source-declared incompleteness of direct three-generation E8 physical realization
items.preserved_text: L05 states that direct three-linearly-independent-generation e8 assignments have Euclidean/signature and natural-two-grading drawbacks, so they are not presented as a complete Lorentzian physical model.

items.raw_role: source comparison of model-building limitations across E6/E7/E8 interpretations
items.preserved_text: L05 treats e6/e7/e8 particle assignments as model-building proposals with distinct limitations: e6 is minimal/one-generation without spin, e7 has chirality/frame limitations, and e8 has Euclidean/grading/mirror-generation issues requiring further theory development.

items.raw_role: source framing: mathematical descriptions as starting surfaces; particle applications remain model-building
items.preserved_text: L05's discussion explicitly presents triality/division algebra/Clifford/Lie/magic-square/eigenspace descriptions as mutually illuminating mathematical starting points while treating generation/Exceptional-Unification applications as model-building rather than established phenomenology.

items.raw_role: source summary irregularity/non-identity guard for final L06 physical action
items.preserved_text: L06 summarizes physical spacetime as a superposition of triality-related regional spacetimes and the full-group generalized Yang-Mills action as reducing to gravity plus a three-generation Standard Model action, but explicitly retains a Kretschmann term, second-order fermion action, possible four-fermion interaction and identical bare masses as irregularities.

guards: Only the source epistemic/model-status or non-identity guard is closed by these atoms.
All named action terms, exceptional algebras, grading structures, fermion sectors and physical fields remain governed by separate mathematical census items.
These raw atoms are not substitutes for those mathematical reductions and make none of that named structure DP-visible.
No Woit or synthesis semantics are used.
